title: 第625章 开启仙尊陵的条件百把仙钥第624章 遗迹广场众修齐聚
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 而就在此时，又是一道流光从远处飞来，落在广场的另一侧。
那是一群身穿白衣的修士，气质超然，为首者是一个容貌俊朗的青年，周身散发着极其强大的气息，举手投足间都有一种与天地共鸣的感觉。
“姜家的人则到了。”有人低声说道，语气中带着几分敬畏。
林轩顺着目光看去，只见那群人正是来自古玄道洲的终极帝族——姜家。
为首那名青年气度不凡，修为同样在半步仙王层次，乃是姜家帝子。
姜家到来之后，其他几个永恒势力的代表也陆续赶到。
太清仙宗、紫霄圣地……那些之前在外面见过的势力天骄纷纷现身，每一个都带着强大的气场和排场，身后跟着一群跟班和侍从。
最后不出意外，那些人看到叶冰凝之后，又全都凑了过来。。
“冰凝仙子，你也在这里！”
“叶仙子，几日不见，你风采依旧啊，真是越来越美了。”
“冰凝妹妹，你也是被那道流光吸引过来的吗？看来我们还真是心有灵犀啊。”
一群天骄围着叶冰凝，各种殷勤献媚，恨不得把心掏出来给她看，有的人甚至开始互相较劲，比拼各自的收获和战绩，试图在叶冰凝面前压对方一头。
但叶冰凝始终是那副冷冰冰的模样，甚至连看都没看他们一眼，仿佛那些人都是一团空气。
那些人也不气馁，反而更加卖力地表现自己，各种吹嘘自己这几天的收获和战绩，试图引起叶冰凝的注意。
林轩站在一旁，看得直摇头。
这些人也是够执着的。
不过他也注意到，人群中并没有古云武的身影。
古神教虽然也有几个弟子在场，但古云武本人并没有出现。
不知道是被传送阵丢到了太远的地方还没赶回来，还是被什么事情耽搁了。
不过不管怎样，对林轩来说都是一件好事。
至少暂时不用面对那个烦人的家伙。
就在林轩暗自想着的时候。
一声低沉的嗡鸣突然从广场中央传来。
那声音虽然不大，却带着一种特殊的频率，仿佛直接震荡在灵魂深处，让所有人的心脏都不由自主地跟着颤动了一下。
所有人的脸色都变了。
齐刷刷地抬头看向广场中央。
只见那尊巨大的金色雕像头顶的金色光团，正在散发着越来越耀眼的光芒。
那光芒从柔和逐渐变得刺目，将整片广场都染成了一片金色。
与此同时，雕像前的虚空中，一行行金色文字缓缓凝聚而成，每一个字都散发着璀璨的光芒，闪烁着古老而庄严的气息。
所有人都屏住了呼吸，死死地盯着那些文字，生怕错过一个字。
只见那些文字写道……
“欲入仙尊陵，需集齐一百把仙钥。”
“将仙钥放入广场四周的石柱之中，方可开启仙尊陵入口。”
“每把仙钥，可使三人进入。”
“仙钥将会在接下来的七天内，陆续在空间各处现世。”
“七日内若未能集齐一百把仙钥，仙尊陵将永不开启，届时所有外来者将被排挤出此墓空间，大墓重新隐没。”
“望诸位……好自为之。”
金色文字在半空中悬浮了片刻，每一个字都散发着震慑人心的光芒，随后缓缓消散，化作点点金光融入空气之中。
广场周围，一片死寂。
content_en:
At this moment, another stream of light flew from a distance and landed on the other side of the square.
They were a group of monks dressed in white, with an aloof temperament. The leader was a handsome young man, exuding an extremely powerful aura, and there was a feeling of resonance with heaven and earth in his every move.
"The Jiang family members have arrived." Someone whispered, with a bit of awe in his tone.
Lin Xuan followed his gaze and saw that the group of people was the Jiang family, the ultimate imperial clan from the Ancient Xuan Dao Continent.
The young man at the head had an extraordinary bearing, and his cultivation level was also at the level of a half-step Immortal King. He was the emperor's son of the Jiang family.
After the Jiang family arrived, representatives of several other eternal forces also arrived one after another.
Taiqing Immortal Sect, Zixiao Holy Land...the powerful geniuses who had been seen outside appeared one after another, each with a strong aura and pomp, followed by a group of followers and attendants.
In the end, as expected, when those people saw Ye Binning, they all came over again. .
"Fairy Bing Ning, you are here too!"
"Fairy Ye, I haven't seen you for a few days, but your style remains the same. You are getting more and more beautiful."
"Sister Bing Ning, were you also attracted by that stream of light? It seems that we really have a connection."
A group of talented people surrounded Ye Binning, trying to show her their hearts, and some even started to compete with each other, comparing their harvests and achievements, trying to outdo each other in front of Ye Binning.
But Ye Binning always had that cold look, and didn't even look at them, as if those people were just a ball of air.
Those people were not discouraged, but instead worked harder to express themselves, bragging about their gains and achievements in the past few days, trying to attract Ye Binning's attention.
Lin Xuan stood aside and shook his head.
These people are also persistent enough.
However, he also noticed that there was no figure of Gu Yunwu in the crowd.
Although several disciples of the Ancient God Sect were present, Gu Yunwu himself did not appear.
I don't know if he was thrown too far away by the teleportation array and hasn't come back yet, or if he was delayed by something.
But no matter what, it is a good thing for Lin Xuan.
At least you don't have to face that annoying guy for the time being.
Just when Lin Xuan was thinking to himself.
“Buzz——!”
A low hum suddenly came from the center of the square.
Although the sound was not loud, it carried a special frequency that seemed to vibrate directly in the depths of the soul, causing everyone's heart to tremble involuntarily.
Everyone's expressions changed.
They all looked up and looked towards the center of the square.
I saw the golden light group above the head of the huge golden statue, which was emitting more and more dazzling light.
The light gradually turned from soft to dazzling, dyeing the entire square a golden color.
At the same time, in the void in front of the statue, lines of golden text slowly condensed. Each word exuded bright light and shone with an ancient and solemn atmosphere.
Everyone held their breath and stared at the words, for fear of missing a word.
I saw those words that read...
"If you want to enter the Immortal Lord's Tomb, you need to collect one hundred Immortal Keys."
"Put the Immortal Key into the stone pillars around the square to open the entrance to the Immortal Lord's Tomb."
"Each fairy key can allow three people to enter."
"The Immortal Key will appear throughout the space one after another in the next seven days."
"If one hundred immortal keys cannot be collected within seven days, the Immortal Lord's Tomb will never be opened. At that time, all outsiders will be squeezed out of the tomb space, and the tomb will be hidden again."
"I hope you all...take care of yourself."
The golden words hung in the air for a moment, each word exuding a shocking light, and then slowly dissipated, turning into dots of golden light and blending into the air.
There was deathly silence around the square.
title_en: Chapter 625 The conditions for opening the Immortal Lord’s Tomb: Hundreds of Immortal Keys Chapter 624 Cultivators gathered in the ruins square
